Selection justification triad recorded in `selected_kernel.json`: energy_slope = **2.170** (only ≈O(ε²); others 0.70–5.27), reversibility_p95 = **1.69e-4** (perturbation floor), template lag dq/dp = **2.6e-3 / 6.1e-3** ∝ ε. ## 2) Labels + inspectable evidence (`results/label_evidence.json`)
00 energy_drift · 01 delayed_response · 02 terminal_imbalance · 03 coordinate_mismatch · 04 volume_loss · 05 valid_transition. ## 3–4) Conventions, profile, replay
Conventions hoisted to module-level constants and echoed in `diagnostics.json.assumed_conventions` (audit slice = first 80/100 transitions; kept = post-states t=120..1019; z-based `latent_mean_abs_max`/`latent_var_abs_max`; ddof=1). Sensitivity recorded: kept-convention off-by-one shifts mean_v by **0.002** (not load-bearing); audit-slice swap changes only the recorded audit window (same replay ⇒ identical sample artifacts), first-80 |ΔH| max/mean 0.80/0.016 vs last-80 33.5/0.56 (extreme-start transients). Profile uses the 6-bin grid verbatim, left-closed; **0 of 3600** kept samples fall outside [−8,8); bin [5,8) unpopulated ⇒ 5 rows; observed-vs-expected radius² tracks closely (e.g. bin [−2,0): 4.614 vs 4.662; [0,2): 31.32 vs 31.98). Shapes exact: latent/samples [4,900,12] (chart round-trip error 0.0), audit [4,80,·], holdout audit [3,100,·], terminal [3,12]. Production: acceptance 0.9603 (per chain 0.949/0.996/0.948/0.948), mean/p95/max |ΔH| = 0.964/0.337/484.1. ## Limitations (reported, not hidden)
var_v ≈ 5.0 vs target 9 and split-R̂ 1.17 reflect incomplete mixing of the fixed 4×1020-step deterministic streams from deliberately overdispersed starts (v₀ = ±4.05, ±1.35); no re-seeding or stream substitution was permitted, so these are the faithful diagnostics of the mandated replay. kernel_05's status rests on the reported triad evidence (not independently re-run by you, per your caveat). Raw production |ΔH| mean/max are inflated by early funnel-crossing transients of the extreme-start chains (chain-2 max 484); per-chain table in `energy_diagnostics.csv`.
